svg.text: zawn: a narrow sea cleft roofed by chockstones
deep passage needs a fault or old adit (weaker fit)
Rounded granite stacked into tors, blazing saffron lichen,
pink thrift and heath over white quartz sand and turquoise.

g.text: Ground level: tor stack, thrift cushions, a red hut beyond.

svg.text: Logan stone: it rocks when pushed
View from the pod, looking west (south ← → north), with the reef wreck's mast in front. Below the water: cutaway, depth compressed.
